CQL Hub (https://www.byteray.com/cql-hub, source https://github.com/ByteRay-Labs/Query-Hub)

Several NGSIEM playbook queries in lib/ngsiem-playbooks.ts are adapted from
CQL Hub; each credits its source query. CQL Hub's readme (checked at commit
a453fcb09118894840a4e00b0db0f9807ba8441d) states: "Released under the MIT
License. All queries are free to use, share and adapt — attribution is
appreciated." The repository has no separate LICENSE file, so the standard MIT
text is reproduced below.
